reconciliationPolicy.unit: relative percent; individual snapshot residuals retain the source field unit
reconciliationPolicy.rule: A relative difference <=0.01% is accepted and retained in residual metadata without altering printed values or inserting a balancing plug. A difference >0.01% requires manual review. Relative tolerance never waives missing source evidence, OCR digit errors, incorrect report scope, or an unreported FX field.
reconciliationPolicy.supersedesPreviousRule: Replaces the former blanket acceptedAbsoluteDifferenceMillionVnd=10 rule as a standalone acceptance threshold.
